purpose: Expand baseline dispatch so foundation-only lanes receive lane-specific baseline evidence instead of staying in a common bucket.
core_laws: Baseline expansion is not strict cleanliness.
Every active lane should receive a lane-specific check object, even if strict validators are future debt.
Patch-pack payload and generated/build outputs must not dominate source-runtime validation.
Toolchain availability may make a lane measurable, but does not prove build/runtime correctness.
JSON evidence parse debt is real evidence debt, not runtime-code debt.
